# Read-only resource description for nhanaz.io.vn

There is no application API or write endpoint. The [OpenAPI document](https://nhanaz.io.vn/openapi.json) describes the static GET resources that agents can retrieve, including Markdown context, the public entity graph, the sitemap, and discovery manifests.

Do not send credentials or private data to these URLs. Use the canonical page before quoting a claim, and use the [GitHub repository](https://github.com/NhanAZ/nhanaz.io.vn) for source history.
